hello.text: Hello, love. Mind the step, it's older than I am. Only just.

place.text: Wakewell Abbey. Keepers, a chapel, some hens and a great deal of washing. The falls are across the lake. Aubin will tell you about them. At length.

waker.text: Nobody who comes to here remembers, love. A bit of a dream, and then the dormitory ceiling. We call you Wakers. It's not much of an answer. It's the one we've got.

levy.text: The Council's levy took our lay brothers for the gap. I'm sure the war needs them more than my hens do. I'm sure of it most days. Don't tell Duvane I said that.

gone.text: Love! Look at you, all grown up and wandering. Are the Hallams feeding you? Wenna will. She feeds everyone, and then sends them off to work it off.
